verdict.rationale: Decagon documents a general integrations layer (no-code integrations, MCP support, Browser Actions for systems lacking native integration) that implies it can connect to ticketing/helpdesk systems and act within them, but no evidence explicitly names Zendesk, Salesforce, or Intercom, nor describes bidirectional ticket/context syncing or a standalone deployment mode.  missing for 10: named helpdesk platform integrations (Zendesk/Salesforce/Intercom), explicit two-way ticket sync mechanics, confirmation of standalone (non-helpdesk) operation mode.
